text:
deploybot: Canary healthcheck failed for release v3.1.0 — 4/6 checks failing; automatic pause engaged. See incident INC-2025 for details. Run `/deploy inspect 3.1.0` for status.

ramya: spotted elevated 502s hitting the embedder > tokenization boundary in us-east. Correlates with canary start at ~11:12 UTC. @theo can you grab sampler logs?

theo: grabbing logs now. If tokenizer binary is the vector, we should rollback the canary image to v3.0.7 and re-run an isolate test.

sre-oncall: please pin the release slot and hold downstream lanes. I'll extend the hold for +90m on the change window to give time for validation. Also adding a temporary soft trigger: if 5xx rate >1.5% for 5m, auto-rollback.

elena: okay to bump window. I'll update calendar and send the stake-holder ping. Drafting release note addition: "Canary paused due to increased 5xx from tokenizer; rollback and re-validation in progress."

ramya: executing rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/tokenizer tokenizer=v3.0.7 && kubectl rollout status deploy/tokenizer -w`. Rolling back now.

theo: rollback completed, canary metrics back to baseline. Recommend keeping slot frozen and scheduling a narrow canary (5-10% traffic) in 45m with extra KV cache logging enabled. If stable, we can gradually unfreeze.

deploybot: Hold active for lanes: stable, experimental. Resume checklist: confirm post-rollback metrics in /dashboards/canaries, update release_notes/delays.md, and run `/deploy canary --pct=10 --duration=15m` to validate before `/deploy resume`.

elena: sending stakeholder notice: "Release v3.1.0 delayed — investigating tokenizer regression; rollback performed and revalidation scheduled." Pinging product and legal for awareness.

sre-oncall: will monitor for spike regressions; I've added an alert runbook to the incident and assigned to paging rotation. If flakiness reappears after reduced canary, prepare rollback PR and cut emergency patch. :warning:

ramya: scheduling the small canary now and enabling verbose kv-cache trace. Tagging @theo and @sre-oncall for the 15m window.

theo: ack. If we get consistent errors, I'll open the rollback PR with the revert diff and link to the postmortem stub.

elena: updating internal calendar: US window moved +90m from 23:00 UTC to 00:30 UTC. Will post final update after the narrow canary.
